records.prompt: A fictional API sorts events by the tuple (CreatedAt, Id). Its cursor stores both values, but the next-page filter is only event.CreatedAt > cursor.CreatedAt. Explain how this loses data, state the correct strict tuple predicate, and give a regression case. Do not execute code.

limitation: Verifies real model and authoritative transport; does not establish authenticated Azure end-to-end, tools, sandbox or production acceptance.
